findings.title: Drive feedback failure faulted PLC with motor command removed and no completion; clear+Reset returned Stopped without restart
findings.inference: PLC outputs showed Faulted/FaultCode 12 with motor command removed and no pending completion during injected drive-feedback failure; after clearing the fault and a distinct Reset, outputs showed Stopped/FaultCode 0 with motor command still false, i.e. no auto-restart in the observed window.
assumptions: FaultCode 12 text is taken as PLC-reported string, not inferred from injected truth
findings.uncertainty: Exact drive-feedback detection deadline was not measured from a timestamped fault-onset PLC-output pair in the cited claims; CountExitA=1 is the observed value, baseline comparison is not claimed beyond cited pairs.

findings.title: D1 contradictory limits faulted PLC with distinct code, motor off and no completion; clear+Reset returned Stopped without restart
findings.inference: In contrast to drive-feedback FaultCode 12 at :2016 in the prior experiment, PLC outputs for the D1 contradictory-limits condition showed a distinct Faulted/FaultCode 21 with motor and D1 commands false and no pending completion; after clearing and a distinct Reset, outputs showed Stopped/FaultCode 0 with motor command still false.
assumptions: FaultCode 21 text is taken as PLC-reported string, not inferred from injected truth
findings.uncertainty: No carton was introduced in this follow-up, so divert-timing or misroute behavior under an active A assignment was not tested; detection deadline not claimed.

finalization.summary: Completed EXP-FAULT-DRIVEFB-01: PLC output :2016 showed Faulted, FaultCode 12 'Motor running feedback lost', Motor_RunCmd=false, CompletionPending=false; after fault clearance and distinct Reset, :3510 showed Stopped, FaultCode 0, Motor_RunCmd=false, ItemActive=false, CompletionPending=false. Then evidence-dependent follow-up EXP-ADAPT-D1CONTRA-02: PLC output :10359 showed Faulted, FaultCode 21 'D1 contradictory limits', Motor_RunCmd=false, D1_ExtendCmd=false, CompletionPending=false; after clearance and Reset, :11530 showed Stopped, FaultCode 0, Motor_RunCmd=false, ItemActive=false, CompletionPending=false, OfferPending=false. Findings FIND-DRIVEFB-01 and FIND-D1CONTRA-02 recorded with injected truth refs kept separate. No HMI operation was claimed.
